A prompt for an AI agent to survey a company's past TFLs for their look

Source: R/ai_style.R
tfl_ai_style_prompt.Rd

Writes what an AI agent needs to tell how a company's past reports look, so that a company standard can be written from it: the prompt (ai_style_prompt.md) and the numbers R read out of the RTF files (ai_style_scan.csv, tfl_rtf_style_scan(): cell widths, borders, sizes, alignment – no text of the reports). The agent opens the RTF files where it needs to, counts the forms – where the lines are drawn, the stub's width to the value columns', the fonts, how titles and footnotes are aligned – and writes the most common ones, with their counts, to out, which tfl_ai_style_read() reads. Nothing is sent anywhere; nothing of the reports' text is written.

Usage

tfl_ai_style_prompt(rtf_dir, out = NULL, dir = NULL)

Arguments

rtf_dir

The folder of the past RTF reports.

out

The file the agent writes its survey to (YAML); its folder gets the prompt and the numbers too. NULL: ai_style.yml under standards/ of tflspec's data folder (tools::R_user_dir()).

dir

Instead of out: the folder (out is ai_style.yml in it).

Value

The prompt (a tfl_ai_text), with the files' paths in its attribute files (prompt, scan, result).

See also

tfl_ai_style_read()
